question: What is the meaning of recycling  instructions in relation to end-of-life data?
description: Recycling instructions in relation to end-of-life data provide critical information on how to properly dismantle and process products at the end of their life cycle. These instructions ensure that recyclable materials are not compromised during disassembly, preserving their reliability and recyclability. They also guide the environmentally responsible treatment of products, minimizing the environmental impacts of product disposal and supporting the recovery of recycled materials. By following these instructions, companies can optimize recycling rates and maintain compliance with local and global recycling regulations.

Moreover, product return guidelines are essential for reintegrating 
products into recycling. Companies can enhance product recycling rates 
by outlining consumer return processes and fostering greater consumer 
participation in CE strategies (Malmgren and M¨otsch Larsson, 2020).

ucts, a step critical for recovering valuable materials. These instructions 
ensure that recyclable materials are not compromised during disas­
sembly, preserving their reliability and recyclability (Vanegas et al., 
2018). Similarly, end-of-life handling protocols guide the environmen­
